architecture_decisions.truth_model_separation: Strictly preserves separation: Outreach Event != Evidence Record != Claim != Lifecycle != Opportunity Tier.
architecture_decisions.claims_engine_reuse: 100% reused existing append-only claims engine (record_evidence_source, record_claim, link_claim_evidence). Zero duplicate engines.
architecture_decisions.opportunity_engine_reuse: 100% reused existing deterministic opportunity engine (evaluate_broker_opportunity). Zero manual tier assignments.
architecture_decisions.migration_status: NO DDL migration required. Existing SQLite DDL and prospects.db schema already support PHONE_OUTREACH evidence sources, outreach_log_id foreign keys, exact-1 subject claims, claim_evidence link table, and materialized facility columns.
architecture_decisions.facility_scope_guard: Facility scope is strictly mandatory when recording verified telephone claims. Corporate switchboard calls cannot create facility claims without explicit facility context.
architecture_decisions.conflict_handling: Conservative non-destructive behavior. If an existing claim is already VERIFIED with a different value, new telephone statement is recorded as an evidence source linked with relationship='CONTRADICTS' and flagged for review with '[CONTRADICTION REVIEW NEEDED]', preserving the prior accepted truth from accidental overwrite.

commercial_carrier_use_NO.action: Recorded in evidence source notes (no unapproved enum invented in facilities check constraint)

broker_friendly_status_ASSET_CARRIERS_ON.effect: Evaluates to RESTRICTED tier (policy restricted; NOT added to suppressions/DNC)

ui_behavior.default_state: Verified facts section is initially collapsed / inactive (hasVerifiedFacts: false). Normal call logging requires zero extra interaction.
ui_behavior.activation: User explicitly checks 'Record verified facts learned during this call' to reveal the structured form.
ui_behavior.default_values: All structured factual dropdowns default to 'Not discussed / Unknown'. Never defaults to Yes.
ui_behavior.confirmation_guard: Explicit user confirmation checkbox is mandatory: 'I personally obtained this information during this call and the entries above accurately reflect what was stated.' Without this, verified claims are blocked from creation.
ui_behavior.facility_notice: Displays clear amber warning if no facility is selected, prompting operator to choose a facility context.

api_behavior.atomicity: Single SQLite transaction (with conn:). If claim creation fails, transaction rolls back cleanly.

response_data.normal_call: Returns standard outreach log and engagement state dictionary (100% backwards compatible).
response_data.verified_call: Enriched with evidence_source_id, claims_created, contradictions_detected, old_opportunity_tier, new_opportunity_tier, old_company_tier, new_company_tier.

scenarios_tested: 4. asset-only response does not become broker acceptance
5. private fleet independent from carrier use
7. UNKNOWN / NOT DISCUSSED = no verified claim
10. one facility claim does not leak to sibling facility

browser_qa.shortlist_cockpit: Renders 200 OK with modal and collapsible verified section intact.
browser_qa.master_directory: Renders 200 OK with modal and collapsible verified section intact.

known_limitations: Corporate switchboard calls cannot create facility claims without selecting a specific facility context.
Negative statements without canonical SQLite schema enum mappings are preserved in evidence source notes rather than inventing unapproved claim enums.
Contradictory telephone statements against prior VERIFIED claims flag for review rather than overwriting accepted truth.
